summary: Iteration 10 — full coverage of 3 long-mix optimization features. Backend: 12/12 new pytest cases in test_iter10_features.py PASS (?tag filter on /api/mixes including AND with ?q, /api/mixes/tags shape+sort, generate_tags 401/404/502/400-when-disabled, PATCH tags persistence + cache invalidation + empty-array clear). Full pytest regression: 97 passed + 8 skipped (Redis only) in 15.42s across 8 test files (105 total, +12 new vs iter9 baseline of 85). Frontend e2e: tag-cloud, mix-tags row, tracklist-search, performance-pads-pagination ALL PASS — but found and FIXED a CRITICAL crash in MixEditModal.jsx (TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined reading 'length'). Root cause: useEffect on mix change reset form state without the new `tags` field, so form.tags became undefined → form.tags.length and form.tags.map crashed the modal. Fixed by adding `tags: Array.isArray(mix.tags) ? mix.tags : []` to the form reset. After fix: Edit modal opens cleanly, existing tags render as chips, manual tag input works (Enter creates chip with remove-tag-{name} testid, X removes it), AI TAG click returns 502 → 'AI TAG GENERATION FAILED' toast shown, SAVE persists tags ('METADATA UPDATED' toast). Tag-cloud on Library: chips render with counts (test-vocal·2, test-uplifting·1, test-dark·1), click filters mix-grid (e.g. test-uplifting → 1 card), URL syncs to /?tag={name}, CLEAR ✕ button resets, direct /?tag=X pre-selects chip. Mix-detail page: data-testid='mix-tags' row visible with mix-tag-{name} links, clicking navigates to /?tag={name} on Library. Tracklist search visible only when >8 tracks: count shows '15 TRX', search 'Lambda'→'1/15' (1 row), search '128'→'0/15' (no track had bpm=128 in seed), clear button resets to '15 TRX'. Performance pads pagination visible only when >8 tracks: 'BANK 1/2 · TRX 1-8/15', NEXT→'BANK 2/2 · TRX 9-15/15' (pad-9..pad-15 render, pad-1 absent), PREV→'BANK 1/2 · TRX 1-8/15' (pad-1..pad-8 render, pad-9 absent). All 105 backend tests pass; one critical frontend bug found and fixed in scope.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. useEffect reset form without tags field -> form.tags=undefined -> 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' crashed entire modal on open. Patched to include `tags: Array.isArray(mix.tags) ? mix.tags : []` in the reset object.

action_items: Review the MixEditModal.jsx fix (line 73-86 useEffect) — the same pattern (resetting form without all fields) could re-introduce the bug if more form fields are added later. Consider initializing form state from a single helper that accepts a `mix` and returns the full default form object, used both for useState's initializer and the useEffect reset.

Optional: MixUpdate Pydantic model does not accept `tracks`. The review request anticipated PATCHing `{tracks:[...]}` but the backend silently drops it (since extra='ignore' or unknown fields are stripped by Pydantic). I planted tracks via direct mongo write. If admin should be able to edit cue-sheet tracks via the API, add `tracks: Optional[List[CueTrack]] = None` to MixUpdate.
critical_code_review_comments: MixEditModal.jsx line 73-86 (now fixed): the useEffect spelled out form fields manually instead of merging — fragile pattern. Refactor to a fromMix(mix) helper to keep useState initializer and useEffect in sync.

Cache key in /api/mixes uses string interpolation `mixes:list:{q}:{genre}:{tag}` — works, but tags containing ':' would break key parsing. Tags are kebab-case so safe in practice, but worth a normalization step (e.g. urlencode) for defence in depth.

/api/mixes/tags pipeline limits to 80 tags. With a global tag taxonomy this could become misleading (the rarest 81st tag would never appear). Either expose a `?limit=` param or document the 80-tag cap.

PerformancePads pagination computes tracks/page=8 implicitly. If banks are not always size 8, label 'TRX X-Y/N' must derive from PADS_PER_PAGE constant. Code review confirms it does (line 50-66) — clean.
CueTrackList search debounce is fine for 100-track sets but for 1000+ track imports consider useDeferredValue or a 150ms debounce so each keystroke doesn't recompute the filter eagerly.

rca of the issue: MixEditModal.jsx crash RCA: setForm initial state on line 17-19 includes `tags: []`, but the useEffect on line 73-85 (triggered when prop `mix` changes) called setForm with a NEW object literal that omitted the `tags` key. React's setState replaces (does not merge) — so form.tags became undefined the moment a mix was loaded into the modal. Then any of the lines `form.tags.length === 0` (line 198) or `form.tags.map(...)` (line 201) threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)'. Reproduction: open admin → click any EDIT (pencil) icon → screen replaced by react error overlay. Fix: include `tags: Array.isArray(mix.tags) ? mix.tags : []` in the useEffect's setForm call. Also handles backwards-compat for old mix docs missing the tags field. Verified: edit modal now opens, chips render for existing tags, manual add/remove works, AI TAG → 502 → toast, SAVE persists.
